decisions.statement: The body is the jpeg alone.
The device secret is the one header naming the phone.
Nothing naming Alan rides along with the bytes.
Every send ends in one sentence, shown on the camera and posted as a notice.
A send says whether the picture got there as well as what to read.
The per-request timeout restarts on every byte that moves.
The whole transfer is bounded by a second timeout of thirty seconds.
A send waits for no network to arrive.

definition: the Swift sending a picture to alanwalton.com
